method.static: pipeline-independent GLB parser (glb_audit.py): vertices = POSITION count per primitive, triangles = indices/3
method.godot: Godot 4.6.3 headless load of the imported scenes (model_probe.gd): surfaces, generated mesh LODs (RenderingServer.mesh_get_surface lods)
method.lod_rule: per surface Godot draws the coarsest generated LOD whose edge_length*scale projected to the screen is <= mesh_lod_threshold (1 px). perspective: edge*scale*1366/(d*2*tan(fovx/2)) <= 1 with fovx from fov 43 and 1366x630; orthographic: edge*scale*630/size <= 1. Validated on ENG-01 field with RenderingServer primitives in frame (lod_eng01.json): exact match at 15 distances and 7 ortho sizes.
method.drawn_triangles_keys: world_dN = perspective camera N metres from the model (world zoom N on terrain at y~1); city_zN = orthographic city zoom N; field models scale 1.15, preview 1.0; armory = SubViewport 442x258, fov 46, distance from the armory capture camera to the model bounds centre
method.texture_vram: width*height*4 bytes (RGBA8 in GPU memory), *4/3 with mipmaps; imported format read from .godot/imported/*.ctex headers

external_png_textures (infantry, ENG-07..result: lossless WebP in .ctex, RGBA8, no mipmaps (not VRAM-compressed)

extracted_glb_textures (ENG-05, ENG-06).result: lossless WebP, RGB8 -> RGBA8 in GPU, mipmaps

lod2_field.why: existing field models 20.3k-22.0k tris / 11.4k-12.6k verts; Godot draws ~3.3-3.8k at the battle camera and 7.6-9.9k at the closest zoom; 24 visible members per army * 12 surfaces = 288 draw calls (+ shadow pass) today - fewer surfaces is the cheapest saving

lod1_preview.why: existing previews 33.7k-36.7k tris; armory and training show one model in a 442x258 SubViewport

textures.albedo_normal_orm_max: 1024x1024 per set, <= 2 sets per unit (body/cloth + equipment), lod2 may reuse lod1 textures
textures.import: VRAM compressed (ETC2/ASTC on iOS via import_etc2_astc, BPTC/S3TC desktop), mipmaps ON, normal maps as normal_map
textures.why: existing infantry textures are lossless RGBA8 without mipmaps (1 MiB each, 36 files, aliasing at 16 px soldier height); warrior_visual.gd sets LINEAR_WITH_MIPMAPS_ANISOTROPIC, which needs mipmaps

lod2_field.why: existing ENG-06 field 34.8k tris / 22.6k verts but Godot auto-LOD only reaches ~14.5k at the battle camera (coarse LODs never selected); clean topology should let auto-LOD drop further; horse + rider + lance share one skeleton (43 joints)

lod1_preview.why: existing ENG-06 preview is 159.6k tris / 90.2k verts (ENG-05 130.7k) - far above what the 442x258 armory view resolves

textures.import: external files next to the GLB (no embedded duplicates), VRAM compressed, mipmaps

file_size.why: existing infantry GLBs 1.0-1.8 MB (textures external); knight 6.8/11.0 MB because 26 images are embedded AND extracted
